messages:
mira: Heads up — deploybot flagged a crash in the embed worker on eu-west1. Small hotfix image built (artifact sha256:abcdef123456...). Need expedited approvals to pin and push canary in the current change window (now). @josh can you PTAL? @ops_oncall please confirm rollback criteria.

deploybot: Automated notice — Release candidate hotfix/embed-crash-fix v2026.03.21-hot1 ready. Action: awaiting approvals for CANARY rollout in eu-west1. Links: https://ci.redwood/1234 (artifact) · https://deploy.redwood/status/5678 (canary dashboard).
josh: Quick question — does this touch kv-cache schema or migrations? If no, I can approve now.
sylvie: no schema/migration. ran the smoke script against staging kv-cache, looks clean. approving. :thumbsup:
ops_oncall: ack. Rollback plan: immediate rollback to previous image v2026.03.20-9 (sha256:aa11bb22) if error rate > 2% sustained over 10m or latency regression > 30%. Healthchecks: /health/embed, token timeout 2s. I'll monitor and take action. :eyes:
mira: thanks. pin request: after canary passes we'll pin the stable tag to the new digest. proposed pin command: ```kubectl set image deploy/embed embed=registry.redwood/hotfix@sha256:abcdef123456 --record``` Proceeding with 5% canary once approvals logged.
deploybot: Approvals recorded: sylvie, josh, ops_oncall. Initiating CANARY: 5% traffic to eu-west1. Tracking dashboard: https://deploy.redwood/canary/5678
josh: Canary checked at +6m — 0 errors, p95 latency stable. green to proceed to 25%.
deploybot: Canary rollout progressed to 25% (eu-west1). Observability hooks enabled (trace sampling + logs).
mira: I'll draft the release note now: "embed worker: fix crash when KV cache miss coincides with concurrent rehydrate — reduces 500s under burst load." PR: https://git.redwood/pr/894. After 25% steady for 15m we can pin and promote to stable.
ops_oncall: watching. Reminder: if error spikes or SLO breaches, I'll trigger rollback and post incident in #incidents. Otherwise stand by for final pin.
josh: 25% stable at +18m. no regressions. approve final pin.
mira: final pin done: stable -> sha256:abcdef123456. release note pushed. Thanks all. :rocket:
